scripts.test:go: which go >/dev/null 2>&1 && (cd packages/go && go test -v ./...) || docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/packages/go:/app -w /app golang:1.22 go test -v ./...
scripts.test:dart: which dart >/dev/null 2>&1 && (cd packages/dart && dart test) || docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/packages/dart:/app -v dart-cache:/root/.pub-cache -w /app dart:stable sh -c "dart test 2>/dev/null || (dart pub get && dart test)"
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:python && npm run test:go && npm run test:dart
